○ Thought for 16.4s (Cache eviction behavior violates requirements because accessing an entry via read operations fails to promote it to the most-recently-used position. Relying on default map in...)
● Ran (npm test)
● Explored 1 file (cache.test.js)
● Edited 2 files (cache.js, cache.test.js)
● Ran (npm test) (ctrl+o to expand)

  Fixed the bugs and added the requested features in src/cache.js, along with unit tests in test/cache.test.js.

  Changes in src/cache.js

  • Recency updates on get and set: get(key) and set(key, value, options) delete and re-insert existing keys in this.map so they move to the most-recently-used position.
  • Expiration handling in has, size, and keys: Added #getAlive(key, now) and #purgeExpired(now) so expired entries (e.expires <= now) are removed and excluded from has(key), size, and keys(),
  without altering LRU order.
  • keys() ordering: Updated keys() to return live keys most recently used first ([...this.map.keys()].reverse()).
  • Eviction order on set: When adding a new key to a full cache, set purges all expired entries first (#purgeExpired(now)) before evicting the least recently used entry if still at capacity.
  • Per-entry ttlMs and ttlMs: 0: set(key, value, options) accepts { ttlMs } (falling back to this.ttlMs), and ttlMs === 0 sets expires = Infinity so entries never expire.
  • peek(key): Added peek(key) to read a live entry's value (or remove it and return undefined if expired) without changing LRU order.

  Verification

  Ran npm test (node --test): all 11 tests passed (0 failed, 0 skipped).
